label.description: Human-readable name for this debug configuration

adapter.description: Debug adapter this configuration runs with.

request.description: The adapter launches a program; it cannot attach to a running one.

program.description: Path to the Zorglub33 assembly file to debug

entrypoint.description: Label to start execution from. Defaults to whichever of main, start, run, or entry is defined in the program.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause the debugger before executing the first instruction.
